## About 
Australian high divers who rose to fame after dominating the Red Bull Cliff Diving World Series. She once held the title of a six-time consecutive champion from 2016-2019, and 2021-2022. She has won medals for the CAMO International Canadian Championships, the Elite Junior Diving Championships, and the Australian Youth Olympic Festival.
## Before fame
She trained at the Hunter United Diving Academy. Subsequently, she became part of the NSW Institute of Sport.
## Trivia
Before her competitive diving success, she embarked on a career as an acrobatic trampolining and diving entertainer on cruise ships, sailing through the waters of the Mediterranean and Caribbean.
## Family life
She is from Newcastle, New South Wales.
## Associated with
She trained with Olympic medallists [Melissa Wu](https://www.famousbirthdays.com/people/melissa-wu.html) and [Matthew Mitcham](https://www.famousbirthdays.com/people/matthew-mitcham.html).
